name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.156.0 — The design seed asks for three records with a declared origin, never three of the client's real records: each design/mocks/records/<entity>.json is now {"provenance": "real"|"synthetic", "records": [...]}, so a pre-launch product with no customers tags its invented records synthetic and passes SEED — where the real-only gate left it with no legitimate input at all. The three-record floor, the wireframe record-hit check, and the preference for the client's own records are unchanged; the accepted seed-done mark now discloses each entity's provenance. 7.155.0 — An exclusion answer stays the client's to change until the work is signed off, with a Change answer control on every answered row before then and a dated read-only record and 409 refusal after; a taken-back client request can be put back on the walk page, the client index, and the exclusion row it produced; and confirming a journey now shows an immediate receipt instead of looking like nothing happened. 7.154.0 — /spec:run now opens the spec's own git worktree by default, before anything else runs — --in-place is the deliberate opt-out, and a worktree that cannot be created is a hard stop, never a silent continuation in place. The design, build, and review stages are no longer separate slash commands: their bodies moved under spec/doctrine/stages/ as prose /spec:run alone executes, and the state-machine hook now gates only /spec:plan and /spec:run. The ledger still records via for the fleet's escapes-per-CLEAN query.
